g.text: stop conditions; first check per mode
FAN n · disjoint owners, native, when permitted

FAN / JOIN · WHERE WORK GENUINELY OVERLAPS
intake → fail; ambiguous scope or ownership → fail
no failing check → fail; demo passes early → re-scope
edit before evidence → fail; workaround ≠ done
no output or labeled substitute → fail
missing sections, script, validator, band → fail
no grant → ask once; Deny → unstaged
failing demo or pytest · docs impact
reproduce or cite failure · root cause
STAGE × PATH · ↺ = REUSED FROM THE OTHER PATH
